info.name: Feature Flag Management System API
info.description: Run 'Login (Admin)' first — it stores the JWT. Then run 'List environments' to store the Development API key used by the Evaluation folder.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const f = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('flagId', f.id);
const dev = f.rollouts.find(r => r.environment_key === 'development'); pm.collectionVariables.set('rolloutId', dev.id); }
